NBA DFS Picks for Wednesday, November 4 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Wednesday, November 4 · 11 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 4, 7:53 PM ET

Nikola Jokic (DEN) is the top-projected player on the Wednesday, November 4 DraftKings main slate at 58.4 DraftKings points for $12,300. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 50.7, $10,300) and Karl-Anthony Towns (NYK, 48.8, $8,300) are next.

Brayden Burries (MIL) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.97 projected points per $1,000 at $3,900.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 4, 7:53 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.

Nikola Jokic (DEN) at 58.4 projected DraftKings points for $12,300, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) at 50.7 projected DraftKings points for $10,300 and Karl-Anthony Towns (NYK) at 48.8 projected DraftKings points for $8,300 lead the SPAGS model on the DraftKings main slate, as of November 4, 7:53 PM ET.

Brayden Burries (MIL) at 5.97 projected points per $1,000 for $3,900, Kingston Flemings (ATL) at 5.95 projected points per $1,000 for $4,400 and Aday Mara (OKC) at 5.93 projected points per $1,000 for $4,300 lead the DraftKings main slate by SPAGS projection per dollar, as of November 4, 7:53 PM ET.
